title: Sparkly present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='giftGlow'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5e7e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d42a54'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5b800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0'>
    <polygon points='14,20 16,26 22,28 16,30 14,36 12,30 6,28 12,26'/>
    <polygon points='84,14 85.5,19 90,20.5 85.5,22 84,27 82.5,22 78,20.5 82.5,19'/>
    <polygon points='88,60 89.5,64.5 94,66 89.5,67.5 88,72 86.5,67.5 82,66 86.5,64.5'/>
    <polygon points='10,72 11.5,76.5 16,78 11.5,79.5 10,84 8.5,79.5 4,78 8.5,76.5'/>
    <polygon points='50,8 51.2,12 55,13.2 51.2,14.4 50,18.4 48.8,14.4 45,13.2 48.8,12'/>
  </g>
  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x='20' y='42' width='60' height='44' rx='4' fill='url(#giftGlow)'/>
  <!-- box lid -->
  <rect x='16' y='36' width='68' height='12' rx='3' fill='#ff7d97'/>
  <rect x='16' y='44' width='68' height='3' fill='#ffb0c0'/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon -->
  <rect x='45' y='36' width='10' height='50' fill='url(#ribbonL)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='36' width='2' height='50' fill='#fff1a8'/>
  <!-- bow loops -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='28' rx='14' ry='10' transform='rotate(-25 37 28)' fill='url(#ribbonL)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='28' rx='14' ry='10' transform='rotate(25 63 28)' fill='url(#ribbonL)'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='28' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(-25 37 28)' fill='#fff1a8' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='28' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(25 63 28)' fill='#fff1a8' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- bow tails -->
  <path d='M42 34 L34 46 L40 44 Z' fill='#f5b800'/>
  <path d='M58 34 L66 46 L60 44 Z' fill='#f5b800'/>
  <!-- bow knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='6' fill='#ffd633'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='30' r='2' fill='#fff6cc'/>
</svg>
